long_biography.plain_text:
Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan was born in Al Ain in 1961, a son of Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the UAE's founding president. After training at the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst, he served in several military roles and became Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi in 2004. Following the death of his predecessor Sheikh Khalifa, he became Ruler of Abu Dhabi and was elected UAE President in May 2022.

His public story is therefore one of hereditary rule, military preparation and state leadership, not a conventional entrepreneurial fortune. Reporting identifies substantial private holdings across the wider Al Nahyan family, while stressing that some family interests are intertwined with government assets. Because the public record does not isolate his own principal private holdings, Abu Dhabi's oil revenues and sovereign investment funds should not be presented as his personal property.
